summary: Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 7, 2026, reporting Phase 4 drill results from its Maestro Project in British Columbia, including 164 metres of 0.72 g/t AuEQ. The press release details assay results, expansion of the Prodigy gold-silver discovery, and plans for Phase 5 drilling in September 2026. With a working capital of $2.6 million and a drill permit for 37 sites, the company is positioned to continue exploration. No transaction, strategic review, or corporate event is announced. This is a routine operational update on exploration progress, not a special situation.
